name: Bendigo TAFE Mick Young Scholarship
summary: A course fee reduction of up to $500 for Bendigo TAFE students in severe financial difficulty.
key: This scholarship can benefit domestic students with a reduction of their course fees, up to the value of $500.
who: Students experiencing severe financial difficulties who would otherwise struggle to pay their fees
